name: Miami
blurb: Flashy cars, flashier people. No shortage of health food.

name: New York
blurb: Where drivers act like get paid to honk their horns.

name: Boulder
blurb: Where people line up to climb 14-ers like New Yorkers line up for the latest Stüssy merch.

name: Montana
blurb: Where some animal is always watching you.

name: Las Vegas
blurb: Where the most interesting conversations happen at the bar at 5:00 am.

name: Joshua Tree
blurb: Bouldering by day, stars by night, a hot tub with a desert view.

name: Orange County
blurb: Cookie cutter homes and the Pacific as their front door.

name: Montreal
blurb: Tim Hortons but with French architecture.
museum: the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts

name: La Paz
blurb: Whale sharks and the good kind of quiet.

name: La Ventana
blurb: Kiteboarding town. Dirt roads and wind every afternoon.

name: Roatan
blurb: An island of biohackers, world class reefs, and one road.

name: Santiago
blurb: Parks with every sport imaginable.
museum: the Museum of Memory and Human Rights

name: Patagonia
blurb: Mate in the mountains. What else do you need?

name: Buenos Aires
blurb: Chimichurri steak, mate and football.

name: Iguazu
blurb: Waterfalls that make Niagara look like a tap.

name: Lisbon
blurb: Hills, tiles, a tram that arrives when it feels like it.

name: Madrid
blurb: Beautiful parks.

name: Granada
blurb: Order a drink, get fed. The Alhambra up the hill, the Sierra Nevada behind it.

name: London
blurb: A city that charges rent on the air, then apologizes for the weather.

name: Brussels
blurb: Where fries are a food group and the waffles are load-bearing.

name: Amsterdam
blurb: Bikes have right of way over everything, including you.

name: Marseille
blurb: The bouillabaisse is worth the detour. Nothing else here is in a hurry.

name: Hyeres
blurb: Riviera views at village pace. The wild flamingos make the mosquitos almost worth it.

name: Antibes
blurb: Nice on one side, Monaco on the other, the sea every morning.

name: Edinburgh
blurb: A castle on a volcano, and rain in every direction.

name: Scottish Highlands
blurb: Aviemore, Skye, Glencoe. Twelve dry hours and worth every soaking.

name: Iceland
blurb: The ring road, a campervan, and a sun that refuses to set.

name: Munich
blurb: Where sausage on a bread roll with a beer counts as a light snack.

name: Innsbruck
blurb: Via ferrata on Saturdays, the climbing gym on Tuesdays, the Nordkette out every window.

name: Hallstatt
blurb: Lakes you can drink from and a tour bus every nine minutes.

name: Casablanca
blurb: Tagine on every corner and the slow realization that the movie was filmed in Burbank.

name: Dakhla
blurb: A lagoon in the Sahara where the wind is the only punctual thing there.

name: Mumbai
blurb: Twenty million people and not one of them in a hurry to let you past. The sea is right there but it's not for swimming.

name: Seoul
blurb: Spicy food and damn good k-pop.

name: Chiang Mai
blurb: More cafes than people. Khao soi for breakfast.

name: Bangkok
blurb: Where a taxi, a moving truck and the family mini-van are all just scooters.

name: Hong Kong
blurb: Skyscrapers with hiking trails behind them. Dim sum and stairs.

name: Tokyo
blurb: Convenience stores, alleys, animal cafes, and trains that apologize for being early.

name: Minakami
blurb: Onsens, snow, and a vending machine on every mountain road.

name: Kathmandu
blurb: Permits, a duffel, and dal bhat power, twenty-four hour.
